correctness.rationale: A rigorous first-denominator reduction and exact strict-floor error identity reduce all possibilities. For u>=34, exact modular and parity comparisons and positive-endpoint concavity inequalities exclude every s>=3 and determine s=0 versus s=1. The finite boundary 2<=u<=33 is fully exhausted by exact integer/rational arithmetic in the embedded reproducible checker; no finite sampling stands in for the infinite proof. Mathematical inequalities, exceptional tie and strict conditions were individually reconstructed.

originality.rationale: Chu 2023 handles the Upsilon<=3 uniqueness criterion, not Upsilon=4 classification; Nathanson 2022 gives pointwise general candidate search but no uniform periodic optimizer, and the previously published I4 interval record covers this ray at m=3 only. Search aliases, comparative implications, and inspected primary statements support originality of the global result, subject to documented unindexed-literature risk.
residual_risks: An unindexed classical two-unit-fraction optimizer classification or a stronger general result may subsume the claim.
The closest indexed first-denominator-four paper was compared from accessible statements/record and archived scientific claim, not from a complete rereading of every page of its original full text.
Some older historical ledgers could not be fully recovered; available recent archives and searchable passages were checked without reconstructing absent files.
